title: Microsoft Sentinel Scheduled Analytics Rule Schema
description: Schema for Microsoft Sentinel Scheduled Analytics Rule templates. Covers both the community / content-hub YAML format and the ARM template JSON format (Microsoft.SecurityInsights/alertRules). When loading an ARM template the converter automatically extracts the nested 'properties' object.

id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the analytics rule. Used as the basis for the XDR detectorId.

name.description: Display name of the analytics rule (community YAML field). Maps to XDR displayName and, when no alertTitle override is given, to alertTitle.

description.description: Description of what the rule detects. Maps to XDR alertDescription.

severity.description: Severity level of the alert. Direct match with XDR alertSeverity.

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'Deprecated' maps to isEnabled=false; all other values map to isEnabled=true.

requiredDataConnectors.description: Data connectors required by this rule. Sentinel-specific, not carried over to XDR.

queryFrequency.description: How often the rule runs. Accepts ISO 8601 duration (PT1H, P1D) or community shorthand (1h, 1d, 30m). Rounded to the nearest supported XDR frequency: 1H, 3H, 12H, 24H. NRT rules (kind: NRT) map to '0'.

queryPeriod.description: Lookback period for the query. Mapped to XDR lookbackPeriod (ISO 8601 duration, clamped to parity limits) on the flexible (SentinelOnly) path; constrained (DefenderOnly/Mixed) rules use a default lookback matched to the chosen frequency.

triggerOperator.description: Operator for the result-count trigger. XDR always triggers on any result row, so this is not carried over (a warning is emitted).

triggerThreshold.description: Result count threshold. XDR has no equivalent threshold concept (a warning is emitted).

tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactics. XDR supports only one alertCategory so the first mappable tactic is used; a warning is emitted when multiple tactics are present. Tactics not present in the XDR category list (PreAttack, Reconnaissance, ResourceDevelopment, ImpairProcessControl, InhibitResponseFunction) are mapped to SuspiciousActivity.

relevantTechniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs (community YAML format). Maps directly to XDR mitreTechniques.

query.description: KQL query. Maps to XDR queryText. WARNING: Sentinel-specific tables (SigninLogs, SecurityEvent, AuditLogs, etc.) are not available in Defender XDR. The query must be reviewed and adapted.

entityMappings.description: Mappings from query columns to Sentinel entity types. Converted to XDR impactedEntities. Unsupported Sentinel entity types (File, MailMessage, AzureResource, CloudApplication, DNS, IoTDevice, SecurityGroup, SubmissionMail, MailCluster, Malware) are skipped with a warning.

entityType.description: Sentinel entity type. 'Host' maps to XDR 'Machine'; 'Account' maps to XDR 'User'. All others are a direct name match where supported.

fieldMappings.description: Maps entity-specific identifiers to query result columns. The 'columnName' value is used as the XDR entityIdentifier.

identifier.description: Sentinel entity field name (e.g. FullName, Address, Url). Informational only; not carried over to XDR.

columnName.description: KQL result column that holds the identifier value. Used as the XDR entityIdentifier.

alertDetailsOverride.description: Dynamic alert property overrides based on query columns. Sentinel-specific; not carried over to XDR.

customDetails.description: Custom key-value pairs attached to the alert. Sentinel-specific; not carried over to XDR.

incidentConfiguration.description: Settings for incident grouping. Sentinel-specific; not carried over to XDR.

eventGroupingSettings.description: Settings for how events are grouped into alerts. Sentinel-specific; not carried over to XDR.

sentinelEntitiesMappings.description: Additional Sentinel entity mappings. Sentinel-specific; not carried over to XDR.

version.description: Semantic version of the analytics rule template.

kind.description: Rule kind. 'NRT' maps to XDR frequency '0' (Near Real Time); 'Scheduled' uses the queryFrequency value.
